counterfactual_missing_items: frowning, forehead wrinkling, eye closure, and nasolabial fold depth are symmetric on both sides
decisive_items: the right lower lip deviates inward, whereas the rest of facial movement is symmetric
When she smiles, the right lower lip deviates inward; frowning, forehead wrinkling, eye closure, and nasolabial fold depth are symmetric on both sides.
Magnetic resonance imaging of the temporal bones and internal auditory canals is normal
response.rationale: R3 exactly matches the classic presentation of congenital unilateral lower lip palsy: isolated right lower lip deviation on smiling/crying with all other facial movements symmetric, normal development, and normal imaging. C1 is a redundant completion of R3 adding laterality already present in the raw spans. R2 is contradicted by symmetric frowning and forehead wrinkling, which are not expected in Moebius syndrome.

rejected.why: Contradicted by symmetric frowning, forehead wrinkling, eye closure, and nasolabial fold depth, which argue against Moebius syndrome; also lacks other features like abducens palsy or limb anomalies.
